feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 5 -- Operate -> Policy Decisions (/portal-v2/policy-decisions). Recreated from the prototype's own `isPolicyDecisions` block ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 4578-4657) and its `pdStates`/`pdFilterNote`/`pdRows` derivation (20247-20328), transcribed into policyDecisionsModel.ts and pinned by unit assertions. Four decisions, one in each state (proposed / live / due / expired), four state counters that double as filters, a knowledge-base info dot, rows that expand in place into the full record (owner / signed / next review / risk register, why this is the position, compensating control, where it stands today) and their per-state actions (Sign it off for proposed, Renew it for due/expired, Withdraw and fix instead for all). The fixture is policyDecisionsData.ts, now the single home of the decisions -- overviewData re-exports it as OV_POLICY_DECISIONS for the Overview lane, so the two can never disagree.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason unrelated to the page.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/policy-decisions. App.tsx declares it BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow it -- Policy Decisions is a plain, param-free route.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree; this manifest needs the Part 5 pages deployed first.

PERSISTED-SESSION FLAKE (known): when WebView2 is already authed, the two input steps against #email/#password can fail while the rest runs green because auth persists. N-2 of N with only those two red is a PASS for the feature.

THE FILTER IS DRIVEN VIA A REAL CLICK on a counter CARD (a button), not a native <select> -- the UI executor can click a button, so unlike the Risk Register's selects this filter is exercised for real (PD23-PD25).

STATUS/ACTION SEPARATION is asserted: a proposed decision offers Sign it off but not Renew (PD21-PD22); a due/expired one offers Renew but not Sign it off (PD18, PD20). Withdraw is on every row. These pin pdActions().
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
